name: SMP files subject vocabulary
notes: Two levels. Level-1 topics are broad headings; level-2 topics refine them. Give level-2 tags where they fit; a level-1 tag may stand alone when no level-2 topic fits. FAST headings are the closest OCLC FAST topical or geographic headings; the place facet China--Shanghai applies to the whole collection.
